column1: # Packages per installer component (functions/components.sh), one per line:
# "a|b": alternatives — satisfied by any installed one, else the first your
# "?pkg": optional — skipped quietly when no enabled repository has it.
# Packages every component needs are in packages.txt. Nothing here is a GPU
# driver: functions/detect.sh only adds optional helpers for a driver in use.
# Build tools: install.sh builds Quickshell from source when no repository has it.
